chapters.label: Live: the 2014 semi-final
chapters.text: The 2014 Futsal Euro semi-final. Russia against Spain, three all, in extra time. Just over a minute left! Eder Lima sends Robinho free, and he makes no mistake. Russia win, four three!

chapters.label: Replay: calm in front of goal
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. The pass finds Robinho in space. He stays calm and scores. Russia are into the final!

chapters.label: The move on his card
chapters.text: Now the move on his card: the Brazilian step-over. His foot circles over the ball, the defender leans, and Robinho goes the other way!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: step over the ball to make the defender lean the wrong way!
